language: Static ASL alphabet handshapes, numeral prototypes, ILY, and nonverbal gesture poses
angle_convention: Initial targets only: 25 degrees extended, 85 degrees partial curl, and 145 degrees flexed. Calibrate after construction; no wrist motion is used.

gestures.name: I love you (ILY)
gestures.description: Informal ASL I-L-Y handshape. A static hand pose; palm orientation is fixed by how the hand is mounted.
gestures.reference_note: ASL ILY combines I, L, and Y handshapes.

gestures.name: ASL number 1
gestures.description: Index extended; other fingers and thumb curled. Mount the hand in the intended palm orientation.
gestures.reference_note: Static numeral handshape; check orientation against the reference.

gestures.name: ASL number 2
gestures.description: Index and middle extended; requires those fingers to be visibly separated by the hand construction.
gestures.reference_note: Static numeral handshape. The mechanism has no finger-spread axis.

gestures.name: ASL number 3
gestures.description: Thumb, index, and middle extended; ring and pinky curled.
gestures.reference_note: Static numeral handshape; ASL 3 uses thumb, index, and middle.

gestures.name: ASL number 4
gestures.description: Four fingers extended, thumb curled.
gestures.reference_note: Static numeral handshape; natural finger spacing matters.

gestures.name: ASL number 5
gestures.description: All five fingers extended.
gestures.reference_note: Static numeral handshape; natural finger spacing matters.

gestures.name: Okay circle gesture
gestures.description: Thumb and index form a circle; the other three fingers extend. Not an ASL word. Requires the thumb servo to reach the index; gesture meanings vary by culture.
gestures.reference_note: Prototype assumes thumb-index contact is mechanically achievable.

gestures.name: Middle finger gesture
gestures.description: Middle finger extended while the other fingers curl. Obscene in many contexts; this is a gesture, not an ASL lexical sign.
gestures.reference_note: A static gesture. Palm direction must be selected in the physical mounting.

gestures.name: Peace / V gesture
gestures.description: Index and middle extended; remaining fingers curl. Recognition depends on fixed palm orientation and finger separation.
gestures.reference_note: Static gesture pose; no wrist motion.

gestures.name: Thumbs up
gestures.description: Thumb extended and four fingers curled. The hand must be mounted with the thumb pointing upward.
gestures.reference_note: Static gesture pose; orientation is fixed by construction.

gestures.name: Shaka / hang loose
gestures.description: Thumb and pinky extended; the middle three fingers curl. The hand must be mounted in the intended orientation.
gestures.reference_note: Static gesture pose; regional meaning varies.

gestures.name: Rock horns
gestures.description: Index and pinky extended; middle and ring fingers curl with the thumb holding them.
gestures.reference_note: Static gesture pose; thumb placement depends on the mechanism.

gestures.name: Open palm
gestures.description: All fingers extended. A generic hand pose, not labeled as hello or stop.
gestures.reference_note: Static pose; palm orientation is fixed by construction.

gestures.name: Closed fist
gestures.description: All fingers curled. A generic hand pose, not labeled as yes.
gestures.reference_note: Static pose; thumb tuck depends on construction.

gestures.name: ASL letter A
gestures.description: Closed fingers with the thumb extended along the side. Single letter pose only; not a spelled word.
gestures.reference_note: ASL manual alphabet handshape. Fixed palm orientation and thumb placement must match the reference.

gestures.name: ASL letter B
gestures.description: Four fingers extended together; thumb folds across the palm. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb to rest across the palm; fixed palm direction matters.

gestures.name: ASL letter C
gestures.description: Fingers and thumb curve into a C-like opening. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Requires coordinated partial curl and a visible curved gap; tune after construction.

gestures.name: ASL letter D
gestures.description: Index extended; other fingers curl with thumb placed near them. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Thumb placement and palm orientation need physical review.

gestures.name: ASL letter E
gestures.description: Fingers curl toward the thumb. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb to meet or cover curled fingertips; verify the mechanism can do this.

gestures.name: ASL letter F
gestures.description: Thumb and index meet; middle, ring, and pinky extend. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Same basic finger configuration as the okay-circle preset; contact and palm orientation determine the recognizable letter.

gestures.name: ASL letter I
gestures.description: Pinky extended; other fingers curl. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Static pinky-up shape; orientation matters.

gestures.name: ASL letter L
gestures.description: Thumb and index extended; other fingers curl. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Thumb must extend in the correct plane.

gestures.name: ASL letter M
gestures.description: Fingers curl over the thumb. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Finger angles alone cannot guarantee thumb-under-fingers placement; mechanical prototype candidate.

gestures.name: ASL letter N
gestures.description: Fingers curl over the thumb in a compact handshape. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Shares the fist target with M in this five-angle model; thumb placement distinctions are not actuated separately.

gestures.name: ASL letter O
gestures.description: Fingers and thumb curve toward an O-like opening. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Same coarse angles as C; fingertip curvature/contact geometry must distinguish the opening.

gestures.name: ASL letter S
gestures.description: Closed fist with thumb across the front. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Same coarse targets as a fist test; thumb placement/palm view is not encoded by the angles.

gestures.name: ASL letter T
gestures.description: Closed fingers with thumb positioned between fingers. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Thumb-to-finger placement must be designed into the mechanism.

gestures.name: ASL letter U
gestures.description: Index and middle extended together; remaining fingers curl. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Index and middle should remain adjacent; no finger-spread servo is available.

gestures.name: ASL letter W
gestures.description: Index, middle, and ring extended; thumb and pinky curled. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: Static handshape; fixed palm orientation matters.

gestures.name: ASL letter X
gestures.description: Index bent into a hook; remaining fingers curl. Single letter pose only.
gestures.reference_note: A single flex joint may not reproduce the hooked fingertip; tune after construction.

gestures.name: ASL number 6
gestures.description: Thumb touches pinky while the other fingers extend. Single static numeral shape.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb-to-pinky opposition/contact and suitable fixed orientation; verify physically.

gestures.name: ASL number 7
gestures.description: Thumb touches ring finger while the other fingers extend. Single static numeral shape.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb-to-ring opposition/contact and suitable fixed orientation; verify physically.

gestures.name: ASL number 8
gestures.description: Thumb touches middle finger while the other fingers extend. Single static numeral shape.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb-to-middle opposition/contact and suitable fixed orientation; verify physically.

gestures.name: ASL number 9
gestures.description: Thumb touches index finger while the other fingers extend. Single static numeral shape.
gestures.reference_note: Requires thumb-to-index opposition/contact and suitable fixed orientation; verify physically.

gestures.name: Finger gun gesture
gestures.description: Index and thumb extend; other fingers curl. A nonverbal pose, not an ASL word.
gestures.reference_note: Thumb direction depends on hand construction and fixed palm orientation.

gestures.name: Index point gesture
gestures.description: Index extends while the other fingers curl. A generic point, not an ASL word.
gestures.reference_note: Static pointing pose; direction is fixed by hand mounting.
